input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I haven’t been able to send those picture messages—MMS, I think they’re called—for a few hours now. I’m not very good with technology, so I’m hoping you can help me fix it.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you also need my date of birth, or is that enough?

It looks like my phone isn’t able to send MMS messages right now. Also, I see that my mobile data is turned off, but I’m connected to the network with excellent signal and data roaming is on. What should I do next? I’m not sure how to turn mobile data on, and I get a bit nervous messing with these settings.

Yes, please! I’d appreciate step-by-step help with turning mobile data on. I get a bit anxious with these things, so please go slowly and let me know if there’s anything I should be careful about. Will turning it on mess up anything else on my phone, like my photos?

I checked, and at the top of my screen, I see the signal bars, it says 5G, and there’s a little icon that looks like a circle with a line through it—I think that means data is off. I don’t see anything that says “Mobile Data” directly up there. What should I do next?

Okay, I tapped the icon, and now I see a different symbol at the top—it looks like a little phone with some lines next to it. I think that means mobile data is on now. What should I do next? Will this let me send picture messages again?

I just tried, but I still can’t send a picture message. It’s still not working, even though the mobile data is on now. What should I do next? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why isn’t this fixing it?

I’m not really sure what APN settings are, but if it won’t delete any of my photos or messages, I guess I can try. Can you please explain what I need to do, step by step? And just to be sure—resetting this won’t mess up anything important, right?

I checked, and Wi-Fi Calling is already turned off on my phone. Is there something else we can try to get my picture messages working?
I checked, and my messaging app already has permission for SMS, storage, and phone. Is there anything else that could be causing the problem? I really just want to be able to send pictures again.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
